runtimeSettings.sandbox.remediation.root.en-US: Run FirmDeck under a dedicated non-root service account, then restart it.
runtimeSettings.sandbox.remediation.root.zh-CN: 请使用独立的非 root 服务账号运行 FirmDeck，然后重启。

runtimeSettings.sandbox.remediation.runt.en-US: Install or repair a supported sandbox runtime, then restart FirmDeck.
runtimeSettings.sandbox.remediation.runt.zh-CN: 请安装或修复受支持的沙盒运行时，然后重启 FirmDeck。

runtimeSettings.sandbox.remediation.unsa.en-US: The sandbox is unavailable and execution is running without OS-level isolation. Configure a signed Windows runtime or an isolated host.
runtimeSettings.sandbox.remediation.unsa.zh-CN: 沙盒不可用，执行正在无操作系统级隔离的模式下运行。请配置已签名的 Windows 运行时或隔离主机。

runtimeSettings.sandbox.remediation.user.en-US: Enable Linux user namespaces for the service account, then restart FirmDeck.
runtimeSettings.sandbox.remediation.user.zh-CN: 请为服务账号启用 Linux user namespace，然后重启 FirmDeck。

runtimeSettings.sandbox.remediation.wind.en-US: Initialize the Windows sandbox with administrator permissions before restarting FirmDeck.
runtimeSettings.sandbox.remediation.wind.zh-CN: 请先使用管理员权限初始化 Windows 沙盒，再重启 FirmDeck。

runtimeSettings.sandbox.setup.windowsReq.en-US: An administrator must initialize the Windows sandbox. Run the command below, confirm UAC, then restart FirmDeck.
runtimeSettings.sandbox.setup.windowsReq.zh-CN: 需要管理员初始化 Windows 沙盒。请执行下方命令，确认 UAC 后重启 FirmDeck。
